title: Block-scaled rows on the CPU in the device's declared order
description: host-expert-arithmetic's declared row orders. Host form: every product, lane FMA and reduction step rounded once to FP32 in the order the options declare, within FP32 rounding of quantized-projections in its nvfp4 format. Device form on the CPU: a checkpoint's stored NVFP4 or INT4 matrices (E4M3 scale per 16) weight only in the 16-lane FP32 order, or W4A4 / W4A8 in the integer block order (activations quantized per row by the declared quantizers), 16-bit matrices a row at a time through torch; every row's bits those of the row alone at any row count (row_invariance prompt_rows). The native rows (C++ with AVX2 and AVX-512 paths, built at load) or the same orders in torch where they do not build. Device form on CUDA (matrices whose tensors are CUDA tensors): the same W4A4 and W4A8 matrices on crit's kernel int-block-experts, decode rows in the declared integer block order (the CPU rows' bits), prompt rows by prompt_gemm.

activations.description: device form, nvfp4 matrices: what they multiply: FP32 activations (weight only, the 16-lane FP32 order), E2M1 x 2 per 16 under the matrix's input_scale (W4A4) or INT8 per 32 (W4A8), the integer block order; int4 matrices always W4A8 or W4A4

native.description: device form: the native rows built at load (on: refuse to load without them), or the same orders in torch (off)

threads.description: device form: threads a matrix's rows are split over (-1: physical cores)

prompt_gemm.description: CUDA form, prompt rows (calls of more than 16 rows): native, W4A4 prompt rows on int-block-experts' gemm-native (the activations by its quantize_nvfp4, block-scaled FP4 MMAs on sm_120a, the s8 MMA a 16-block for INT4 weights): NOT the declared order and not row invariant (a prompt row's bits may change with the prompt's length and are not the CPU rows'; the facts' row_invariance prompt_rows false), W4A8 ones as declared; declared, every prompt row on gemm-staged in the declared integer block order, the CPU rows' bits

kernels.name: int-block-experts
kernels.fallback: none on CUDA: a CUDA matrix is refused without it (the CPU form needs no kernel)
